# Fixture registry (test data)

This is NOT a registry anyone installs from. It is the frozen input of the tools' own tests
(`tools/test_tools.py`): a few synthetic `fx-*` packages and the `index/` that `tools/render.py`
produces for them. The tests copy it, next to the working tree's `tools/`, into a throw-away
checkout and mutate it there, so that no test depends on what the real `packages/` hold today.
Nothing here is ever downloaded or built; every URL and hash is made up.

Change a package here, then run `python3 tools/test_tools.py --render-fixture` and commit the result.
